verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers the consumer Gemini Apps (chat, mobile, Deep Research, image generation, scheduling) with no documentation of a headless mode, CLI automation, or CI-friendly invocation for this product; the runtime probe confirms no agent-docs/MCP discovery surface on the Gemini app, and notes the developer API/CLI is a separate product not covered here. Community mentions of 'Gemini CLI' (gemini-comm-14, gemini-comm-15) reference login failures rather than confirming headless/CI capability for this product.
